title: Prepare for a Clinic Conversation
instructions: Read the example aloud for practice, then record your own response with different details.
prompt: Describe a fictional clinic visit and how you would prepare questions. Explain the appointment, the information you would check, and what you would ask a professional to clarify. Speak for 90–120 seconds, use at least six different lesson words, and avoid giving treatment or dosage advice.
reference: I have an appointment at a community clinic next week. Before I go, I will write down the symptom I want to describe and the time I first noticed it. At reception, I will check my name and phone number. If I have a question about an allergy, I will put it on the same card. I might also ask a nurse what an examination involves. If a prescription has a word I do not understand, I can ask the pharmacy to explain the label. I will listen to the professional and take notes instead of guessing. My friend will wait outside, and I will send a message when the conversation is finished.
